_comment: macro_master.json - configuration for the six-engine macro pipeline. Every block is optional; engines degrade to sane defaults when a block is absent. Credentials are NEVER stored here - the API key is read from the environment / _restored/.env.

economic._comment: New opt-in knobs. Defaults reproduce the baseline scorer. Set regime_model='hmm' + model_weight>0 to use the sticky-HMM posterior; use_surprise/use_delevel blend change vs trend; event_trim scales gross down near known events; use_nlp reads context['headlines']/'rbi_text'.

_comment: FALLBACK macro block. STATIC values, used only when no live provider
supplies a signal. They do NOT auto-update, so they drift silently -
which is how 'currency' sat at 84.5 while USD/INR was near 95.9.
LIVE now (fetched every 6h, provenance shown on the dashboard):
currency       FBIL reference rate via RBI
gdp_growth     MoSPI NAS, real GDP YoY computed from constant prices
employment     MoSPI PLFS unemployment rate, person, rural+urban
The values here are only the last-resort fallback for those four.
STILL STATIC (no scriptable source found - see notes per key):
climate, tax - no citable source exists, so their weights were set
to 0. Scoring an invented number is worse than scoring nothing.

gdp_growth.src: MoSPI NAS real GDP YoY, Q1 FY27 computed from constant-price levels (LIVE via MospiProvider)

bond_return.src: FBIL/CCIL 10Y G-Sec benchmark yield. NOT live: FBIL+CCIL render via JS, NSE allIndices exposes index LEVELS only (NIFTY GS 10YR = 2644, which is ~2644 not a yield), FRED unreachable. Do not substitute the index for the yield.

debt.src: RBI/IMF general government debt/GDP. Annual release; SOTW (IMF WEO) gives 83.4 for 2026 but its API silently ignores the country filter, so it is not wired.

employment.src: MoSPI PLFS unemployment rate, All-India, person, rural+urban, all ages (LIVE via MospiProvider)

inflation.src: MoSPI CPI All-India Combined (LIVE via MospiProvider). Rural is 5.23 and Urban 4.31 - the Combined row is the headline.

climate.src: UNSOURCED placeholder. Weight is 0 - not scored. No free citable series exists for this input.

tax.src: UNSOURCED placeholder. Weight is 0 - not scored. No citable series; note the only candidate (GC.TAX.TOTL.GD.ZS) measures tax REVENUE, not the effective corporate rate, and ends FY2022.

currency.src: FBIL reference rate via RBI (LIVE via RbiReferenceRateProvider)

forex_reserves.src: RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement. NOT live: data.rbi.org.in refuses scripted access (SAP token needs a browser fingerprint) and the WSS HTML pages carry only a 3.4KB JS template. Weekly release, so a dated value is defensible.

portfolio._comment: portfolio_inputs below is the LAST-RESORT fallback. The live path is provider_ref -> providers/factory.py:portfolio_inputs, which assembles openalgo (history/positionbook) + account (funds) + price_cache + this static block. Set BLUE_PORTFOLIO_CONFIG=/path/to.json to override the universe/costs per deployment without editing this file. P0 finding (11y walk-forward, net of India costs): no optimiser beat inverse_vol SIGNIFICANTLY (all Sharpe CIs spanned zero), so optimiser choice is stability-driven; the COST lever is ~20x larger than the optimiser lever. Hence rebalance_band_pct=1.0 (cost 268 -> 171 bps for ~0.02 Sharpe).

costs._comment: Conservative India DELIVERY cost model, bps of notional per side. Override for intraday/F&O (STT differs).

sector._comment: Optional Mansfield relative-strength stage. Supply aligned benchmark and sector close series in sector_market_data. Agent is opt-in; any invalid or unavailable advice applies zero-allocation WAIT_AND_SEE limits.

agent._comment: Optional OpenRouter advisory. Set enabled=true and provide a newly rotated OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the repository-root .env file or process environment. Only explicit public text from context.agent_inputs is sent. Suggestions never write configuration or place orders.

screener._comment: Optional pipeline stage. Enable only with an intentionally configured provider or input snapshot; network scraping is never enabled by the default pipeline.

valuation._comment: Optional, offline pipeline stage. Requires caller-supplied company financial snapshots.
